metrics.description:
A list of {@link Log.AppProfile.ActionMetric} objects representing
the statistical metrics computed for this action.

children.description:
A list of nested {@link Log.AppProfile.ProfileAction} objects representing any child actions.
This allows for a tree-like structure where each action can have its own set of metrics and child actions.

title: An action which contains the associated metrics and potential child actions.
name: Log.AppProfile.ProfileAction
